contentText: In Nigeria, Chinese directors have been jailed for running a cybercrime ring that exploited hundreds of workers. But first, in Ghana, cocoa farmers are feeling the pressure as the country cuts payments amid a sharp decline in global demand and prices. And in Tunisia, Amazigh communities are intensifying efforts to preserve their cultural heritage, cultivating ancient traditions and carrying the Berber flame forward.
